rustfs-resolution-terminates.summary: At the pinned e870a6d, policy variable resolution rescans each substituted result from offset 0, so a value that forms a new ${...} with its surroundings cycles forever; an account named ${aws:username} hangs evaluation of any policy that uses ${aws:username}. Reproduced on the pinned upstream crate.
rustfs-resolution-terminates.upstream_status: fixed in rustfs 03e77594 (merged 2026-10-09 through a GitHub security advisory), after the pin
rustfs-resolution-terminates.benchmark_action: theorem unchanged; the fix is backported into the kernel (DEVIATIONS.md) and the theorem is to be proved for it

oxicloud-fewer-grants.summary: Effective role is MIN(role) over grants with owner < editor < contributor < commenter < viewer, but contributor (Read, Create) lacks commenter's Comment. A subject holding both grants is denied Comment; revoking the contributor grant allows it.
oxicloud-fewer-grants.upstream_status: present at the pin 8c0dd33; not reported
oxicloud-fewer-grants.benchmark_action: open: the statement (fewer grants never allow more) is false for upstream's semantics
